privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what Tripvisor collects, why, who processes it, and how you can export or delete it. The short version: we keep only what the app needs to plan and sync your trips, and we never sell it.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Tripvisor is a free, non-commercial holiday route planner built and run by an individual developer. There are no ads, no paid tiers and no selling of data. “We” below means that developer.

sections.heading: What we collect
bullets: Account: your email address, used to sign you in (by email link or Google sign-in) and to contact you about your account. If you sign in with Google we receive your email and basic profile name, nothing else.
Content you enter: trips, dates, places, notes, pinned times, packing lists, accommodation, budgets and expenses.
Places: for each place you add we store its Google place ID and its coordinates. Names, photos, ratings and reviews from Google are fetched when you view them and are not stored on our servers.
Documents you upload to a trip: PDFs and images such as tickets or booking confirmations. They are stored privately in our file storage and are visible only to that trip’s members.
Collaboration: who you share a trip with, their role, and share links you create.

Crash reports and performance data: if the app crashes, a report with the error, device type, OS and app version is sent to Sentry, along with a small sample of performance traces (how long screens and requests take). It doesn’t include your trip content.
paragraphs: We do not collect your contacts, advertising ID or browsing history, and we do not track you across other apps or websites.

sections.heading: Your location
paragraphs: Only if you ask for it (“How far am I?” on Today, or “From my location” on the map), the app reads your current position on your device to estimate distance or draw a line to your first stop. Your location is not saved to your account or sent to our servers. You can turn location access off at any time in your phone or browser settings.

sections.heading: How we use your data
bullets: To run the app: store and sync your trips across your devices, and share them with the people you invite.
To plan routes and suggestions: place names, coordinates and the text you type are sent to the services listed below.
To fix bugs: crash reports help us find and fix problems.
paragraphs: We never sell your data or use it for advertising or profiling.

sections.heading: Services that process data for us
bullets: Supabase: database, sign-in and server functions. Stores your account and trip data.
Google Maps Platform: place search, place details and route times. Receives search text, place IDs and coordinates. Results aren’t stored beyond place IDs and coordinates.
Google Gemini and Groq: AI trip planning and editing. They receive only the text you write in the AI planner and the names of places in the trip, never your email.
OpenRouteService: route optimisation and travel times. Receives coordinates.
Open-Meteo: weather forecasts. Receives coordinates and dates.
OpenFreeMap / OpenStreetMap: map tiles for the web map. The tile servers receive your IP address and the map area you are viewing.
Google Maps SDK: draws the map in the Android app. Google receives device and map-usage data under its own terms and privacy policy.
Cloudflare Pages: hosts the web app; processes standard request data such as IP address to serve pages.
Sentry: crash reports and a sample of performance traces, as described above.
paragraphs: Some of these providers are based outside your country, including the United States. They process data under their own privacy terms and only to provide their service to us.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Your data is kept for as long as you have an account. When you delete your account, your account and your trips, including their places, expenses, share links and the documents and files uploaded to them, are deleted straight away; backups roll over within 30 days. Data saved on your device is wiped when you delete your account, or you can remove it by uninstalling the app or clearing site data.

sections.heading: Your choices and rights
bullets: Export: Profile & settings → Your data → Export my data downloads everything as a JSON file.
Delete: Profile & settings → Delete account permanently removes your account and all your trips. You can also email us to ask for deletion.
Correct: you can edit or delete any trip, place or expense in the app at any time.

Ask: you can request a copy of your data, correction or deletion by emailing {{email}}. Depending on where you live (for example the EU/UK under GDPR) you may also complain to your data-protection authority.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: Data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS). Database access rules make sure only you and the people you share a trip with can read it. No system is perfectly secure, so please don’t store sensitive personal information (such as passport numbers) in trip notes.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: Tripvisor is not directed at children under 13, and we don’t knowingly collect their data.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: If this policy changes in a meaningful way we’ll update the date above and mention it in the app. The current version always lives at this page.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms cover how you can use Tripvisor, a free travel planner. By creating an account or using the app you agree to them. How we handle your data is explained in the privacy policy.

sections.heading: The service
paragraphs: Tripvisor is a free hobby project for planning holiday routes: organising places into days, estimating travel times, drafting plans with AI, and sharing trips with friends. It is provided as-is, and features may change or be removed at any time.

sections.heading: Your account
bullets: You need an email address (or Google account) to sign in. Keep access to that inbox secure; anyone who can read it can sign in as you.
You must be at least 13 years old, or the minimum age for online services where you live.
You can delete your account at any time from Profile & settings.

sections.heading: Your content
paragraphs: Trips, notes, expenses and everything else you enter stay yours. You give us permission to store, process and display them only as needed to run the app for you and the people you share with. When you share a trip or create a share link, anyone with access can see that trip.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
bullets: Don’t use Tripvisor for anything illegal, or to harass anyone.
Don’t try to break, overload, scrape or reverse-engineer the service or its API quotas.
Don’t upload content you don’t have the right to share.
paragraphs: We may suspend accounts that abuse the service, especially where it puts the free service at risk for everyone.

sections.heading: Maps, routes and AI suggestions
paragraphs: Travel times, opening hours, routes, weather and AI-drafted plans are estimates from third-party services (including Google Maps, OpenFreeMap/OpenStreetMap, OpenRouteService, Open-Meteo, Gemini and Groq). They can be wrong or out of date. Always check opening times, local conditions and safety information yourself, and follow road signs and local rules while travelling. Map data and place information are subject to the providers’ own terms, including the Google Maps Terms of Service and the OpenStreetMap licence.

sections.heading: No warranty, limited liability
paragraphs: Tripvisor is provided free of charge, “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind. To the extent the law allows, the developer is not liable for missed bookings, travel costs, lost data or any indirect loss arising from using the app. Keep your own copy of important bookings and documents; you can export your data at any time. Nothing here limits rights you have under consumer law that can’t be waived.

sections.heading: Ending the service
paragraphs: You can stop using Tripvisor and delete your account whenever you like. If the service is ever shut down, we will give reasonable notice in the app where possible so you can export your trips.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these terms; the date above shows the latest version. Continuing to use the app after a change means you accept the updated terms.
